name: update
description: Update an existing automation (scheduled and/or event-triggered). Use this when the user asks to change, edit, or modify an automation's name, prompt, schedule, event trigger filters, or notification settings. Requires `task_id` from `automation_list`. Include `schedule_id` when changing a schedule; include `trigger` when changing event filters (call automation_list_trigger_catalog for allowed providers/types/dimensions; for GitHub repos use automation_list_trigger_resources for numeric repository ids; for Linear teams / projects use the same tool with provider=linear and resource_type=team|project when Linear is in the catalog). Omitting `trigger` leaves existing event triggers unchanged.

task_id.description: The ID of the automation to update (from automation_list)

schedule_id.description: The ID of the schedule to update (from automation_list). Target which schedule row to change when updating schedule fields; optional for content-only edits (resolved from the task). Echoing schedule_id alone does not rewrite the schedule.

name.description: Updated short name for the automation

prompt.description: Updated prompt Grok will execute on each run

cadence.description:
RFC 5545 RRULE describing how often the automation runs. Supported forms:
- "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY" (every day)
- "RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO" or "RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR" (one or more weekdays)
- "RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=15", "RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY"
- "RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY" (every hour), optionally restricted with window_start_time / window_end_time and BYDAY days.
Include when changing the recurrence. Omit entirely (with no other schedule fields) to leave the schedule unchanged. Do not include DTSTART/DTEND — use time_of_day + timezone (and window_start_time / window_end_time for hourly) instead.

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601 date for one-time automations (e.g. '2026-05-25'). Required when changing a schedule to run-once (omit cadence). Defaults to today if not provided.

time_of_day.description: Time in 24h format (e.g. '09:00') when changing a schedule. Defaults to '09:00'. With a `trigger` update, only set together with cadence/scheduled_date. Ignored for hourly cadences (use window_start_time).

window_start_time.description: For hourly (FREQ=HOURLY) automations only: start of the daily run window in 24h 'HH:MM'. Must be strictly before window_end_time; omit both to run every hour all day.

window_end_time.description: For hourly (FREQ=HOURLY) automations only: inclusive end of the daily run window in 24h 'HH:MM' (e.g. '18:00' still fires at 18:00). Omit both to run every hour all day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Defaults to user's timezone.

trigger.description: Replace the event trigger. Same shape as automation_create.trigger (provider, trigger_type, dimensions / email aliases). Call automation_list_trigger_catalog for allowed values. Omit entirely to leave existing triggers unchanged.

provider.description: Event source wire tag from the catalog (e.g. gmail, outlook, github, finance, linear).

trigger_type.description: Event kind from the catalog (e.g. new_email, pr_opened, new_transaction, issue_created).

dimensions.description: Catalog dimension keys → string or array of strings. GitHub dimensions.repo must be a stringified numeric repository id from automation_list_trigger_resources (not owner/name). Linear dimensions.team / dimensions.project must be Linear UUIDs from automation_list_trigger_resources (provider=linear, resource_type=team|project).

from.description: Email alias for dimensions.from. String or array.

to.description: Email alias for dimensions.to. String or array.

subject_contains.description: Email alias for dimensions.subject_contains. String or array.
